_source.title: 获取当前底部库选中行的信息
_source.remarks.text.0: 将会获取当前底部库选中行的库类型、UUID、所属库 UUID
_source.example.text.2: 3. 输出选中行的关键信息（uuid + libraryUuid 可直接传给库管理接口）
_source.returns: 库属性对象，如若为 `undefined` 则获取失败

title: Get the information of the currently selected row in the bottom library
remarks.text.0: It will get the library type, UUID, and the UUID of the library it belongs to for the currently selected row in the bottom library
returns: Library property object; if it is `undefined`, the retrieval failed
